description: This Java source file defines a REST API resource class 'SearchApiResource' for the Fineract platform, providing endpoints for search functionalities including retrieving search templates, performing resource searches, and advanced ad-hoc queries. It uses JAX-RS annotations for REST mappings and Swagger annotations for API documentation.

classes.name: SearchApiResource
classes.description: REST API resource class for search operations in Fineract, handling endpoints for search templates, resource search, and advanced ad-hoc queries.

methods.name: retrieveAdHocSearchQueryTemplate
methods.description: Returns a template for ad-hoc search queries.

methods.name: searchData
methods.description: Performs a search for resources based on query parameters such as query string, resource types, and exact match flag.

methods.name: advancedSearch
methods.description: Performs an advanced ad-hoc search based on complex search conditions sent in the request body.
